item.title: Become a Sponsor
item.description:
Troupe 513 sponsors help students create memorable productions while connecting local organizations with families, audiences, and neighbors who care about the arts.

Your support strengthens the resources and experiences behind every performance. In return, sponsorship can give your organization meaningful visibility alongside a program that brings the Westerville community together.
